entities.name: Mazirek
entities.description: Golgari death priest of Ravnica, a Kraul and effective leader of his race, a pawn of Bolas.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: Friend of Mazirek who helped overthrow Jarad vod Savo and revealed Mazirek as a pawn of Bolas.

entities.name: Sobeslav
entities.description: Person whose life force Mazirek used with his guard retinue to raise the Erstwhile.

entities.name: Erstwhile
entities.description: Liches raised by Mazirek, bound to obey him.

entities.name: Jarad vod Savo
entities.description: Ruler overthrown by Vraska with Mazirek's help.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Planeswalker dragon who used Mazirek as a pawn.

entities.name: Storrev
entities.description: Free-willed lich of the Erstwhile who misled Mazirek and had him killed.

entities.name: Golgari Swarm
entities.description: Guild Mazirek served and was said to have betrayed.

events.summary: Mazirek raises the Erstwhile and helps Vraska overthrow Jarad vod Savo.
events.quote: Mazirek raised the Erstwhile , and helped Vraska to overthrow the reign of Jarad vod Savo .

events.summary: Vraska reveals Mazirek was a pawn of Bolas.
events.quote: Mazirek was revealed by Vraska to have been a pawn of Bolas .

events.summary: Mazirek turns on Vraska; Storrev misleads him and has him killed by a Rakdos Comedy Troupe.
events.quote: when Mazirek turned on Vraska, Storrev misled him and had him killed by a Rakdos Comedy Troupe
